in_sanskrit.name: Pawar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Protector, Guardian
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pawar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Pawar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pawan' which means wind, and it is believed to bring the power and strength of the wind god. This name is bestowed upon a child to instill in them a sense of protection and guardianship, as well as the qualities of strength, courage, and victory.
